liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Peggy-O** (2 reviews): Peggy-O was described as gorgeous; Attendee names Peggy-O and Childhood's End as highlights, along with all of set two [13][14]
- **Samba In The Rain** (2 reviews): Even Samba In The Rain was welcome in the rain-themed second set; Highlights the sequence Box of Rain into Samba, Looks Like Rain, and Here Comes Sunshine [14][16]
- **Feel Like A Stranger** (1 review): The opening Stranger is cut on this soundboard source [11]
- **Beat It On Down The Line** (1 review): Rare Beat It On Down The Line, kicked off by about twenty drum beats, got the crowd shaking [13]
- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): The run of three rain songs leading into Here Comes Sunshine in set two was singled out as very cool [10]
- **Here Comes Sunshine** (1 review): After three consecutive rain songs, the crowd went wild; the opening notes felt like sunshine breaking [20]
- **Uncle John's Band** (1 review): Uncle John's Band emerging from Space was judged quite beautiful [10]
- **Morning Dew** (1 review): At the end, Jerry, jamming hard, lifted his head and smacked loudly into the microphone [20]

## Setlist highlights

- **Childhood's End**: back after 739 archived shows (3659 days); rare: 13 archived performances [21]
- **Mathilda**: back after 739 archived shows (3659 days); rare: 7 archived performances [21]

## The recordings

- **gd1994-07-20.nak300.bleich-sirmick.119553.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): audience recording; 19 songs; 155 min; rated 1/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd94-07-20.sbd.darkstar.12596.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 140 min; rated 3.6/5 by 30 [8]. Said about its sound: Full, fat digital soundboard sound with a solid groove; warns that Feel Like A Stranger is cut; Sound is described as very present, warm and enjoyable, with appealing acoustic sound from Jurry in 1994; Reviewer says the sound is nice and crisp, contrary to claims of bad quality; Jerry sounds fine [11][14][15][17][18]
- **gd1994-07-20.140083.FOB.unknown.Gastwirt.Miller.Noel.t-flac1648**: audience recording; 19 songs; 154 min [2]
- **gd1994-07-20.fob.schoeps.jones.89561.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 155 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [3]

## Around the show

- Attendee found Phil and Bob nice and loud, and ranks it a top-five show of the year [12]
- Blazing hot day, then a heavy downpour about two hours before showtime; clouds broke and sun returned roughly 30 minutes before the opener [13]
- Evening featured rain and a fence that stayed standing rather than being torn down [15]
- Attendee went to all three nights of this run [16]
- Reviewer felt Jerry sounded worn out vocally and musically during the performance [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1994-07-20.nak300.bleich-sirmick.119553.sbeok.flac16**: taped by John Bleich; transferred by SIRMick; source: Source: Audience Recording > Nakamichi 300's with CP-4 caps > Sony WMD-6 > MAC; [1]. Also: Taped by Greg Holtz on Nakamichi CM300s with CP-4 capsules and PZM 30Ds, mixed to D3 DAT; Tape flips were patched using audience-mic recording; the source is a Bleich-Sirmick transfer [1]
- **gd94-07-20.sbd.darkstar.12596.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD> DAT> WAV> CDR> WAV> SHN [8]
- **gd1994-07-20.140083.FOB.unknown.Gastwirt.Miller.Noel.t-flac1648**: taped by Rich Gastwirt; transferred by Charlie Miller and Joe Noel; source: flac16/48kHz ; taper & equipment unknown: (FOB) AUD > Dat (48k); Charlie Miller [2]
- **gd1994-07-20.fob.schoeps.jones.89561.flac16**: taped by Roger Jones w/ Keith Litzenberger's Schoeps; transferred by Watson; source: Schoeps MK4's>Rbox>Sony TCD-D10PRO (mod) FOB [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1994-07-21 Deer Creek Music Center, Noblesville, IN, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1994-07-21-deer-creek-music-center-noblesville-in-usa/) [22]
- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1994-07-21 Deer Creek Music Center, Noblesville, IN, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1994-07-21-deer-creek-music-center-noblesville-in-usa/) [23]
- Poster by Michael Mullen Grateful Dead: [1994-07-20 Deer Creek Music Center, Noblesville, IN, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1994-07-20-deer-creek-music-center-noblesville-in-usa/) [24]
